introHtml: For tasting events, wedding favors, or promotional samplers, custom 1 oz beer mugs and steins offer a unique way to showcase your brand in a miniature format. These small vessels are perfect for craft brewery openings, beer festivals, or as collectible giveaways. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or full-color wrap for maximum impact. Whether used as shot glasses for beer flights or as a novelty item, these tiny mugs deliver big brand recognition.
